accommodation.title: Just for you, combining comfort, nature and complete privacy.
accommodation.text1: Designed for up to 6 guests, O Refúgio combines the rural charm of the mountains with welcoming interiors and gardens made for slowing down. Every stay is completely private, with the entire house, pool and outdoor areas reserved exclusively for you.
accommodation.text2: From the cosy living room and peaceful bedrooms to the outdoor corners and meals around the barbecue, everything invites you to enjoy your time at an unhurried pace, with family, as a couple or with friends.

gallery.title: Discover the light and details of O Refúgio.
gallery.card3Alt: Natural landscape in the surrounding area

booking.title: Choose your dates and secure your getaway.
booking.text: Check availability in just a few moments and request O Refúgio for your stay.

local.title: Between the river, nature and villages, there is always more to discover.
local.text1: From walks along the Douro to river beaches, traditional restaurants, viewpoints and mountain trails, O Refúgio is surrounded by experiences that make every stay even more special.

testimonials.title: A place you always want to return to.
testimonials.quote1: “We had two excellent days, truly a refuge for anyone who likes getting away from the crowds. The house is huge, the view is spectacular and the pool, garden... everything is exceptional. We will definitely be back!”
testimonials.quote2: “A wonderful private place to relax in the middle of nature. O Refúgio was even better than we expected, with incredible views, lots of privacy and hosts who were always attentive. We hope to return soon :)”
testimonials.quote3: “Our best Booking experience. The house combines rustic and modern perfectly, with incredible comfort, breathtaking views and a perfect pool for relaxing. Everything was simply perfect. We hope to return.”
testimonials.quote4: “The view, the welcome and all the amenities in the house. The host is extremely attentive and full of little touches that make a difference.”
testimonials.quote5: “We were looking for peace and found even more. Everything is perfectly equipped, with wonderful spaces and a very well-kept pool. The best part was undoubtedly the kindness and attention of the hosts. It just makes you want to come back.”
testimonials.quote6: “Perfect for relaxing. Fantastic view! The house has everything you need, including a pool and an incredible outdoor area. Very friendly owners. We would happily return 😊”
testimonials.quote7: “The house is impressive: beautiful, comfortable and very clean. Our stay was a 10 out of 10. Without a doubt one of our best experiences — we will be back.”
testimonials.quote8: “Perfect for a family getaway. Large garden, a pool with sun all day and an excellent location. We will definitely return.”

meta.description: Discover O Refúgio: a private house in Castelo de Paiva with a pool, gardens, barbecue and mountain views.

hero.imageAlt: O Refúgio rural house with pool and mountain views
hero.title: An entire house, just for you, in the heart of the mountains.
hero.text: Between the tranquillity of the Castelo de Paiva mountains and the open views over the Douro, O Refúgio was designed for those looking for privacy, comfort and time to slow down.

overview.title: A private refuge for unhurried days.
overview.text1: O Refúgio is a fully private house, reserved entirely for the guests who choose it. With capacity for up to 6 people, it is ideal for a family getaway, a couple or a group of friends, away from the crowds and surrounded by nature.
overview.text2: The atmosphere combines rural charm with modern comfort, creating a welcoming and peaceful space designed to be enjoyed slowly, both indoors and outdoors.

highlights.title: Everything you need for a completely private stay.
highlights.item1: Entire house exclusively for you (not shared)

spaces.title: Spaces designed for living and resting.
spaces.text1: The house has three comfortable bedrooms designed for different types of stay: one double bedroom, one bunk-bed room and one single bedroom.
spaces.text2: Inside you will also find a cosy living room with a sofa bed, a dining room with rural character and a fully equipped kitchen for everyday use.
spaces.text3: Outside, O Refúgio opens onto several areas: gardens, relaxation spaces, an outdoor grill and a barbecue area with an enclosed veranda-style space where indoors and outdoors come together.
spaces.text4: The private pool completes the experience, providing the perfect place to relax throughout the day.
spaces.card1Text: A calm and comfortable space to rest after a day by the pool, in the mountains or enjoying meals outdoors.
spaces.card11Text: Ideal for children, friends or family stays — practical and flexible.
spaces.card3Text: A cosy interior for relaxing, chatting or watching television in the comfort of a home enjoyed at an unhurried pace.
spaces.card4Text: The most traditional room in the house, full of history, where several generations of the family gathered around the table.
spaces.card5Text: Complete kitchen with hob, oven, microwave and all the utensils needed for everyday use.
spaces.card6Text: Gardens and several corners with chairs, tables and sun loungers for enjoying the outdoors.
spaces.card7Text: Barbecue area with removable glass walls, an equipped kitchen and an ideal space for family meals.
spaces.card8Text: Pool in the garden, perfect for relaxing or enjoying time with the family throughout the day.
